What is the total growth of investment A from the start of 2020 to the end of 2023?

questions.explanation: 1,331 ÷ 1,000 = 1.331 = 1.1³, so the CAGR is 10%. The answer is 10%.

What is the arithmetic mean of the four year-on-year growth rates?
questions.explanation: YoY rates: 10%, 20%, 5% and 25%; mean = 60 ÷ 4 = 15%. The answer is 15%.

Annual revenue (₹ crore)

Year | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Revenue | 100 | 110 | 132 | 138.6 | 173.25

Which is correct about the mean of the yearly growth rates (15%) and the CAGR?
options: The CAGR is slightly lower than the mean of the yearly rates
The CAGR is higher than the mean
questions.explanation: The mean of YoY rates is 15% and the CAGR is about 14.7%. Compounding makes the CAGR lower when yearly rates vary. Answer: the CAGR is slightly lower.
